statements.status_notes: Debian trixie has no security fix yet (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-96512). Upstream commits db669167ca599f2a94cd8a4c5fae9e473c81a2fd and 1820a349687522f51023d1ae5925125f59679a8c remove TZ from sudo's working environment so NOTBEFORE/NOTAFTER checks cannot be shifted via a user-controlled timezone; this rebuild backports those fixes.

Marked no-dsa by Debian Security Team; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-96512

Debian trixie has no security fix yet (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-82474). Upstream commit 71fbe42dcd5a1c8f799540583a2dfb2ae6221edf adds execveat(2) intercept policy checks in ptrace-based intercept mode; this rebuild backports that fix.

Debian classifies this as a policy violation rather than a security issue: the visudo temporary-file symlink behavior can only manifest when the sudoers file being edited is in a world-writable directory. sbx-templates ships sudoers files under /etc/sudoers.d, not a world-writable path.
